subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in prison.

summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in prison on March 28, 2024 by the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York; this is consistently reported by reputable news outlets and confirmed by appeal filings, though direct court documents were not examined.

findings.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to a 25-year prison term.
Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced on March 28, 2024 to 25 years in prison.
Reuters, CNBC, ABC News, NBC4 Washington, and Fox Business all reported that Sam Bankman-Fried received a 25-year prison sentence.
Appeal filings and rulings confirmed the 25-year prison sentence for Sam Bankman-Fried, with no indication of a different term.

gaps: No direct sentencing transcript or official court docket from the Southern District of New York was reviewed; reliance is on secondary news reports.
No Bureau of Prisons inmate record or official Department of Justice sentencing order was accessed to independently verify the exact term length.
No appellate court opinion or docket entry detailing the appeal outcome was examined; only news summaries of the appeal were available.
